Platinum series · RR

Rising Rivals

Released May 16, 2009 · 120 cards

Rising Rivals is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Platinum series, released in English on May 16, 2009. Its main set has 111 cards, plus 9 secret rares numbered beyond the set (120 in total). It includes 104 Pokémon, 12 Trainer and 4 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

33 illustrators worked on Rising Rivals. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (14), Kagemaru Himeno (12), Kouki Saitou (10), Mitsuhiro Arita (8), Masakazu Fukuda (7), Midori Harada (7), Naoyo Kimura (6), Atsuko Nishida (4).
